title: El modelo de Emilie: El Átomo
description: docs/quests/emilie.md § El Átomo. The fight that replaced La pluma, from the fight tester (Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost): its figure, an electron torn off and caught back, its Reacción, the bare nucleus, and its entry in the bestiary. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.pick = id => document.querySelector(`[data-element="${id}"]`).click(); window.said = text => [...document.querySelectorAll('.damage-pop strong')].some(e => e.textContent === text); window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z }, d || 3.4); };

steps.caption: El Átomo: the Meshy nucleus over dark water, three orbits, an electron of fire, water and electricity; the Reacción icon on its plate with its turns
Up close: slate and teal spheres with amber cracks, its drip, the three electrons on their orbits
Atacar · Agua: ¡Ionizado! in water's colour, the bigger number, the water electron going dark and dropping
The water electron lies dark in the pool; its orbit is dim
Water again: Captura, half the number, and the electron goes back up to its orbit
One turn to its Reacción: the icon says 1 and the electrons race round
Reacción with all three: everyone soaked, the bolt through the water, then the fire on whoever it dried
After the Reacción: burns on the party, maybe a Shock
Bare nucleus: the three electrons dark in the pool, every orbit dim, no Reacción icon
The bestiary: El Átomo with its own Meshy model (rule in code on top), its design images (with rings, and the nucleus alone) and its moves
